title: A stack you can watch
hints: Remember each frame's size in a `std::vector`, so `ret` knows how far to move back up. The frame size is `(8 + localBytes + 15) / 16 * 16`.
Check for overflow before moving: the frame fits when `sp - bottom >= frame`. Compare that way round so the unsigned subtraction never goes below zero.

`std::optional<std::uint64_t>` (from `<optional>`) holds either a number or nothing. `return newSp;` gives a value and `return std::nullopt;` gives "nothing"; the caller tests the result with `if (result)` and reads it with `*result`.
